dogWalking.label: Dog walking bookings
dogWalking.prompt: A booking app for my dog walking business. Customers pick a date, a time and their dog's size, and I can see all bookings in one place.

pizza.label: Pizza orders
pizza.prompt: An order form for my pizza shop. People pick their pizza, add their name and phone number, and the orders show up on an admin page.

classes.label: Class sign-ups
classes.prompt: A sign-up app for my yoga classes. People pick a class from the timetable and enter their name and email. I can see who is coming to each class.

bookReviews.label: Book reviews
bookReviews.prompt: A site where I post reviews of books I've read, with a rating out of 5 and the review text. Visitors can read the list of reviews.

party.label: Party RSVPs
party.prompt: An RSVP page for my birthday party. Guests enter their name, whether they're coming and how many people they're bringing. I can see the guest list and the total.

chores.label: Family chores
chores.prompt: A family chore tracker. Each chore has a name, who is doing it, and whether it's done. We can add chores, tick them off and see what's left.

club.label: Club members
club.prompt: A members area for my running club. Members sign in to see upcoming runs and sign up for them. Admins can add runs and see who is coming.

art.label: Art portfolio
art.prompt: A portfolio to show off my drawings. Each drawing has a title, a picture and a description. Visitors see them in a gallery and can send me a message.
